title: The Missing Witness
author: August Quintana
blurb: Rosalind Whitlock, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
